nodes.title: Independent review of the built-stack contract (d6b1d97 + 0c5997a). Found clean: no path for a built stack to dial a real person (always beta, refused at G10); voiceId kept or cleared correctly; no draft-hash drift; built and curated stacks with the same parts price identically for all 7. Found and fixed: (1) availability read 'available' while the runtime refused 'custom'; (2) compile.ts dropped SOUNDS and DELIVERY for built stacks; (3) campaign rate and estimate ignored a built stack's parts; (4) money.estimate silently priced a curated stack that was sent with parts. Handed on: the web client reads getStack(stackId) in 4 places (test panel, beta warnings, call label); the launcher's /v1/health drops components and customStacks.
A built stack is available only when the runtime's health says customStacks: true and every part is available. Healthy parts alone are not enough.
nodes.rationale: The review found the parts reading healthy while the runtime refused stack 'custom'. The person would have picked a stack that could never ring.
nodes.reverse_if: Every runtime in service runs built stacks and the flag is retired by a protocol version bump.
